file: File:Donor Icon of Arseniy of Elasson.png
why: Found by route 1, the category built from the folder's own name: Commons has Category:Arsenius of Elassona and this is its one portrait-sized image of the man rather than of his gospel book. 627x746. He is the Greek archbishop of Elassona who died at Suzdal in 1626, and the donor icon shows him as donor; the other eight files in the category are pages of his 1608-9 gospels in the Kremlin, his reliquary casket, and a facsimile of his signature, none of which are him. There is one Arsenius of Elassona and the category is titled for him.

Found by route 2: Wikidata Q1052577, 'Cedd, Bishop of London; Saint', carries P373 Category:Ceda of Lastingham and P18 is this same file. 768x1024. It is a stained-glass window of TWO named saints, Alban and Cedd, and the title names both; which of the two figures is Cedd cannot be settled off the picture, only off the title's order. Kept on the precedent of basil-of-mangazeya, whose only file shares its frame with Basil of Caesarea. There is one Saint Cedd, the 7th-c. bishop the Greek calendar keeps on 7 January.

file: File:20,000 martyrs of Nicomedia (Menologion of Basil II).jpg
why: Found by route 4, a hand alias: Category:20,000 Martyrs of Nicomedia, which no title built from the folder's own names reaches. 1949x1328. The folder IS the company, not an individual, so a group image is the right kind of picture here and the file names the company and the date it illustrates. It is a Menologion of Basil II miniature of the burning of the church, so it is a SCENE and in landscape; the 28 December feast is the one this folder keeps in all four calendars.

Found by route 4, a hand alias taken from the corpus's own sibling folder: erasmus-of-the-kyiv-caves already carries this file, found there as the P18 of Wikidata Q2072224 «Еразм Печерский». This folder stores the Serbian «Еразмо» read off the Ohrid Prologue's heading for the Julian 24 February, 'Преподобни Еразмо, инок печерски' - the same monk of the Kyiv Caves, the same 24 February, so the same picture. 450x624, which is ON the floor and not over it; it is the smallest icon in the corpus and should be replaced when a better one appears.
